subject: english
stem: Which English sentence preserves the waste trend?
options: Sunday produced more waste than Friday.
Waste dropped from 12 kg on Friday to 5 kg on Sunday.
Waste rose to 12 kg on Sunday.
Waste stayed at 8 kg every day.

optionRationales.reason: Sunday produced more waste than Friday.：方向相反。
Waste dropped from 12 kg on Friday to 5 kg on Sunday.：句子正確對應起終值與下降方向。
Waste rose to 12 kg on Sunday.：Sunday 是 5 kg。
Waste stayed at 8 kg every day.：只有 Saturday 是 8。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「英文句中的主詞、比較方向、數值與範圍全部對應圖表」可推出 Waste dropped from 12 kg on Friday to 5 kg on Sunday.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Waste dropped from 12 kg on Friday to 5 kg on Sunday. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
